annotations.title: SBA size standard for an industry

description: The SBA small-business size standard for a NAICS code, from 13 CFR 121.201, with exceptions and footnotes. Also gives the alternative size standard for 7(a) loans. Search by words if the code is unknown; pass receipts or employees to compare against the limit.

annual_receipts.description: Average annual receipts in dollars, including affiliates (optional)

average_net_income.description: Average net income after federal income taxes, prior two fiscal years, in dollars (optional)

query.description: Words to search NAICS titles, e.g. 'plumbing'

tangible_net_worth.description: Tangible net worth in dollars, including affiliates (optional)

name: size_standard
title: SBA size standard for an industry
